tools/ssl/probe.js: tls.connect to a validated IP literal with servername pinned to the requested host
tools/ping/icmp.js: execFile the system ping binary with an args array and a validated IP literal
tools/ping/tcp.js: net.connect to a validated IP literal for the TCP ping fallback
tools/whois/port43.js: net.connect to validated public registry IPs for legacy WHOIS fallback
tools/geoip/enrich.js: dns.promises.Resolver with explicit public servers for reverse DNS enrichment
tools/traceroute/enrich.js: dns.promises reverse lookup with bounded timeout for traceroute hop enrichment
scanner/connect.js: scanner connects to validated pinned IP literals only
scanner/intel/threatIntel.js: net.connect to validated public DNS resolvers for the optional Spamhaus check
